knowledge:
- key_parameters: fq=Path to the raw merged FASTQ file ;; ref=Path to the reference FASTA file containing the sequences of the SynCom strains ;; outdir=Directory where output files (including log files) will be written ;; thread=Number of threads to use for parallel processing ;; max_len=Maximum length of the reads to be processed ;; phred=Phred score quality encoding type (typically 33 or 64) ;; log_file=A text file containing a list of all paths to the log files generated by Rbec for contamination detection
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing amplicon sequencing data from synthetic microbial communities (SynComs) where reference sequences for each strain are already available, and you need to correct sequencing errors, estimate community profiles, or detect contamination.
- pitfalls: Ensure that the output directory for Rbec exists or can be created. For contamination detection, a separate log file must be generated for each sample first, and their paths must be compiled into a single text file. Clean SynCom samples should generally have 90% or more of their reads corrected; lower ratios indicate potential contamination.

workflows.name: syncom_community_profiling
workflows.intent: Estimate SynCom community profiles and correct sequencing errors using reference sequences.
workflows.stages: 1. Run Rbec to perform error correction and profile estimation using FASTQ and reference FASTA files.
workflows.code:
library(Rbec)
fq <- system.file("extdata", "test_raw_merged_reads.fastq.gz", package="Rbec")

ref <- system.file("extdata", "test_ref.fasta", package="Rbec")

Rbec(fq, ref, tempdir(), 1, 500, 33)

workflows.name: contamination_detection
workflows.intent: Predict contaminated samples based on the recruitment ratio of sequencing reads across samples.
input: log_files (Rbec log files generated for each sample)
workflows.stages: 1. Compile paths of Rbec log files into a single text file ;; 2. Run Contam_detect to identify contaminated samples and generate a distribution plot.
workflows.code:
log_path <- list.files(paste(path.package("Rbec"), "extdata/contamination_test", sep="/"), recursive=TRUE, full.names=TRUE)
log_file <- tempfile()
writeLines(log_path, log_file)
Contam_detect(log_file, tempdir())
